theorems.name: Submission.doragm_annular_monotonicity
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U W : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n) (H : Euclid P → Euclid P) (κ : ℝ), IsOpen W → W ⊆ U → AEStronglyMeasurable (fun x => (approxTangentPlane n R.carrier x).starProjection) R.measure → AEStronglyMeasurable H R.measure → (∀ x, ‖H x‖ ≤ κ) → (∀ X : Euclid P → Euclid P, ContDiff ℝ 1 X → HasCompactSupport X → tsupport X ⊆ W → R.firstVariation X = -∫ x, inner ℝ (X x) (H x) ∂R.measure) → ∀ (y : Euclid P) (s t : ℝ), 0 < s → s < t → closedBall y t ⊆ W → (∫⁻ x in closedBall y t \ closedBall y s, ENNReal.ofReal (‖(x - y) - (approxTangentPlane n R.carrier x).starProjection (x - y)‖ ^ 2 / ‖x - y‖ ^ (n + 2)) ∂R.measure) + ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (κ * s) / s ^ n) * R.measure (closedBall y s) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (κ * t) / t ^ n) * R.measure (closedBall y t) ∧ ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-(κ * t)) / t ^ n) * R.measure (closedBall y t) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-(κ * s)) / s ^ n) * R.measure (closedBall y s) + ∫⁻ x in closedBall y t \ closedBall y s, ENNReal.ofReal (‖(x - y) - (approxTangentPlane n R.carrier x).starProjection (x - y)‖ ^ 2 / ‖x - y‖ ^ (n + 2)) ∂R.measure
